items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: "Look, I'll tell you what I'm going to do for you guys. I'm going to put some beds in here."

ctx.x: just liked jazz musicians. They'd sit and listen all night, and they couldn't play nothing but they'd be right there, you know. Every time there was a jam session they'd stay there as long as the musicians would.

So he had a place, he said, "Well, come on and play. Play for me on --," so he saw us jamming. We didn't worry about it. We had no place to stay, had nothing, you know, and no way to get no food, but we'd be at a jam session that night, you know. So what happened, he said, "I tell you what you do. You come on out there on Saturday and Sunday and play for me," you know, and he said, "Whatever I take in just split it up between you, you know." So we said good. So we went out there and we did that, and he said,…
